rows.summary: A render that finishes after the preview unmounted (Cover Letter or Back to dashboard clicked mid-render) stops before opening its pdf.js document, or destroys it; a render that fails after opening its document destroys it; unmount destroys the document on screen.

A finished render is shown when it is newer than the pages on screen, even while a newer change is still waiting out its debounce or building; only a render older than the pages on screen is dropped. Steady typing with short pauses now updates the preview as renders finish.

Every canvas that leaves the screen (a newer render, a zoom repaint, unmount) or never reaches it (a stale render, a failed paint, a cancelled or overtaken zoom repaint) is shrunk to 0×0 at once instead of waiting for the garbage collector. Not checked on an iPhone.

The preview's mechanics now have gate tests that run all the way to pages on screen, using a stand-in pdf.js (PdfPreview._setPdfjsForTest) and builds the test finishes itself. They cover the typing debounce with pages up, the stale-render drop, the zoom repaint (and none while hidden), the error alert with its message, Retry clearing it, and a failure superseded by a newer change.

The file was killed because it ran out of memory. A test failed on a real bug: a closed Dialog did not give focus back to its opener (confirmed in Chromium, where focus ended on <body>). assert.equal's report on two fake-dom nodes then inspected the whole DOM and React's fibers until the heap ran out. useFocusTrap now hands focus back after the commit, and only when focus was left in a closing trap or nowhere; the tests compare nodes with assertSame; ConfirmProvider clears its hand-off timer on unmount. All three suites run again: 15 tests in about 4 s.

issues: The first focus-trap fix handed focus back even when the same commit had put it somewhere on purpose (an autoFocus field appearing as a dialog closed; nested dialogs closing together).
A zoom repaint that finished at the same moment as a newer render was never shown and never shrunk to 0×0.

Left as is, not a regression: while the preview is hidden with a change pending, a build already in flight still sets status 'ready' (from before this branch). A dev-only HMR edit of PdfPreview.jsx now blanks the preview until the next edit.

notes: A real a11y bug beyond the row was fixed under R3-005: at HEAD before this branch, every kit Dialog (and the phone's Sidebar drawer, which shares useFocusTrap) left focus on <body> when it closed. Three ui-overlays assertions were test bugs and were corrected: the scroll lock accepts fake-dom's undefined for an unset style, the toast replace check counts toasts, and node comparisons use assertSame. fake-dom.mjs gained replaceChildren. PdfPreview exports _setPdfjsForTest for tests. Commit a9814a6 carries the protocol file's Claude-Session trailer, not this session's (it could not be amended without a force-push).
